text:
miguel: Heads up — SI found a firmware mismatch on the on-prem racks from Marketplace partner during staging, blocking our DC swap tomorrow.
priya: Ugh. Which SKU and how many racks affected? Are customer commits at risk? @ava any ETA on site work? :eyes:
ava: 4 racks (32 nodes). Manifest shows FW v1.2.3 but SI requires v1.2.4. They flagged a bootloop on 2 nodes in the staging cluster.
miguel: Exact manifest snippet from partner:
```\nsku: MARKET-RTX-A1\nqty: 32\nfw: 1.2.3\nserials: [redacted]\n```
ops-bot: Inventory hold placed by vendor-inventory-bot for sku MARKET-RTX-A1 — hold_id=hold-7382 — reason: firmware_mismatch.
chris: Can we hotflash at the DC prior to swap? That would need vendor-signed image + 2hr maintenance window per rack. Also need vendor tech on-site for warranty.
orion-si: SI here — vendor declined remote flashing for warranty reasons. We can do swap in two parts: bring 2 racks to staging, validate fw, then proceed. Would add 48h to schedule.
lydia: Sales flags 2 enterprise customers with Dedicated commits starting Mon. If we delay 48h, one customer's onboarding SLA is missed. Need contingency.
priya: Options I see:
- ask partner to repallet and ship updated fw nodes from nearby regional stock (if they have any)
- accept staged hotflash with signed image and vendor engineer onsite (cost/time)
- reassign reserved capacity from another region (latency tradeoffs)
who can quickly check partner regional stock availability?
ava: I'm pinging partner ops now. @orion-si can you hold the 2 problematic racks in staging and start diagnostic logs so vendor can confirm bootloop cause?
orion-si: Holding. Logs collected; sharing link: https://files.example/si/logs/hold-7382 (vendor access pending). Will not proceed with swap until partner confirms.
miguel: If partner can't provide regional swap, we may need to fallback to cloud-marketplace burst capacity for the two customers until physical racks cleared. @chris — how fast can marketplace bursting be approved (quota bump)?
chris: We can route to marketplace burst pools but need billing approval for estimated 48k tokens / hour difference — ops finance ping needed. Can stand up within 6hrs technically.
lydia: I'll inform customers with a proposed plan: Marketplace-burst (6hr to stand up) + 48h physical resolution. Need partner commitment by EOD or we escalate credits.
priya: Thanks. @ava please paste partner reply here ASAP. Also create a quick postmortem doc template for the incident path and include the hold_id.
ava: Partner replied — they have 8 nodes regional available and can overnight 24 nodes with firmware v1.2.4, remaining 0. Not great. They offered onsite engineer for hotflash but quoted 10k USD + 24h.
miguel: Okay — decision call in 20m. Tentative plan: accept 8-node swap from partner + marketplace burst for remaining capacity + onboard vendor engineer for hotflash on 2 racks if cost approved.
priya: Logged. I'll coordinate credit/SLAs with sales. Filing escalation to partner PM if they can't hit 24h shipping window. :thumbsup:
